content.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהִים, אַתָּה הַחִלּֽוֹתָ לְהַרְאוֹת לִי שַׁעֲרֵי גְבוֹהִים,
content.transliteration: Adonai Elohim, atta haḥillota lehar’ot li sha‘arē ḡevohim,
content.english: “Adonai, God, You have begun to show me the gates of the heights,
content.comments: Adonai. This first stanza presents Moses’s prayer to God to enter the Land of Israel, paraphrased from the opening verses of our parasha (Deut. 3:23–25).

content.hebrew: הֶעֱמַדְתַּֽנִי בְּחֶבְיוֹן עוֹז, וְחָזִֽיתִי נְגוֹהִים.
content.transliteration: He‘emadtani beḥevyon ‘oz, veḥaziti neḡohim.
content.english: You have let me stand in the hidden place of Your might, and I have seen [its] radiance.

content.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶֽרֶץ רוֹאֶֽיהָ תְמֵהִים –
content.transliteration: E‘ebra na ve’er’ē erets ro’eha temehim –
content.english: Let me cross over, please, and see the Land [that inspires] all who see it [to] marvel”—

content.hebrew: קהל: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים.  (תהלים צ:א)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Tefilla leMoshē Ish ha’Elohim.
content.english: Cong. A prayer of Moses, the man of God.    (Ps. 90:1)

content.hebrew: הִקְדַּשְׁתִּֽיךָ מִבֶּֽטֶן, וּמִשְׁחָר לְךָ מֵרָֽחֶם.
content.transliteration: Hiḳdashtikha mibbeten, umish’ḥar lekha meraḥem.
content.english: “I have sanctified you since the belly, and from your dawn, from the womb.
content.comments: I have sanctified you. This stanza and the next are God’s response to Moses.

content.hebrew: עַתָּה הֶֽרֶף מִלְּהִתְחַנֵּן – תִּזְכּוֹר רַחֵם.
content.transliteration: ‘atta heref millehit’ḥannen – tizkor raḥem.
content.english: [But] now, leave off supplicating ‘Remember to have mercy!’”

content.hebrew: כִּי אֵל עֶלְיוֹן לֹא אָדָם הוּא לְהִנָּחֵם –
content.transliteration: Ki El ‘elyon lo adam hu lehinnaḥem –
content.english: For El ‘Elyon is not a human being, that He would reconsider—
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God; traditional English: “the most high God.”

content.hebrew: קהל: וְגַם נֶֽצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם. (שמואל א טו:כד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Veḡam netsaḥ Yisra’el lo yeshaḳḳer velo yinnaḥem.
content.english: Cong. And Israel’s Eternal One does not lie, and does not reconsider. (1 Sam. 15:24)

content.hebrew: רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה עֲלֵה, וּרְאֵה אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ מִמְּרוֹמוֹ,
content.transliteration: Rosh happisga ‘alē ur’ē et ha’arets mimmeromo,
content.english: “Ascend to the top of the summit, and see the Land from its high point;

content.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּֽעְתִּי לָתֵת אוֹתָהּ לְזֶֽרַע אֵיתָן, אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Nishba‘ti latet otah lezera‘ etan, elohav ‘immo,
content.english: I have sworn to give it to the descendants of Ethan, whose God is with them.

content.hebrew: וְקַח אֶת־יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ וְחַזְּקֵֽהוּ וְאַמְּצֵֽהוּ, כִּי לְנָגִיד אֲשִׂימוֹ –
content.transliteration: Veḳaḥ et Yehoshu’a‘ veḥazzeḳehu ve’ammetsehu, ki lenaḡid asimo –
content.english: Take Joshua, and strengthen and fortify him, for I will place him as a leader”—

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיְצַוֵּֽהוּ יוי לְנָגִיד עַל עַמּוֹ.  (שמואל א יג:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vaytsavvehu Adonai lenaḡid ‘al ‘ammo.
content.english: Cong. Adonai has commanded him [to be] a leader over His people. (1 Sam. 13:14)

content.hebrew: נִיבוֹ לֹא חָשַׂךְ מֵעֲרוֹךְ לָֽנוּ אִמְרֵי מַמְתַקָּיו,
content.transliteration: Nivo lo ḥasakh me‘arokh lanu imrē mamtaḳḳav,
content.english: [God] did not refrain from setting out His word, His sweet utterances, for us.
content.comments: He did not refrain. These final two stanzas are the narrator’s words, praising God and praying for the messianic age.

content.hebrew: וַיְגַל עֵין לִבֵּֽנוּ, בְּהַשְׁווֹת בְּרִיאַת אֲרָקָיו וּשְׁחָקָיו
content.transliteration: Vayḡal ‘en libbenu, behashvot beri’at araḳav ush’ḥaḳav
content.english: And He uncovered our mind’s eye, in making the creation of earth and heaven equal to

content.hebrew: כִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַֽיִם, וְעָלֶֽיהָ יִסַּד רֹב מִצְוֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו,
content.transliteration: Kitsi’at Mitsrayim, va‘aleha yissad rov mitsvotav veḥuḳḳav,
content.english: The Exodus from Egypt, upon which He established most of His commandments and statutes,

content.hebrew: קהל: צַו לָצָו קַו לָקָו.    (ישעיהו כח:י)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Tsav latsav ḳav laḳav.
content.english: Cong. Precept by precept, line by line.     (Isa. 28:10)

content.hebrew: הֱבִיאַֽנִי בְּמַצְרֵף הָאֱמוּנָה, וְהוֹרַֽנִי הָאֲמִתִּי הַמְיֻחָד,
content.transliteration: Hevi’ani bematsref ha’emuna, vehorani ha’amitti hamyuḥad,
content.english: He brought me through the crucible of faith, and taught me the true One, the unique One:

content.hebrew: הָיָה וְהוֹיֶה וְיִהְיֶה; יֶשְׁנוֹ, וְלֹא יִכְחַד.
content.transliteration: Haya vehoyē veyihyeh; yeshno, velo yikh’ḥad.
content.english: He was, is, and will be; he exists, and will never be non-existent.

content.hebrew: יַהֲפֹךְ אֶל עַמִּים שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה לְעָבְדוֹ יַֽחַד,
content.transliteration: Yahafokh el ‘ammim safa verura le‘ovdo yaḥad,
content.english: He will transform nations [to speak] pure language, to worship Him together,

content.hebrew: קהל: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יוי אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד. (זכריה יד:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Bayyom hahu yihyē Adonai eḥad ushmo eḥad.
content.english: Cong. On that day, Adonai will be one, and His name will be one. (Zech. 14:9)

content.hebrew: חזן: וְהָיָ֧ה יו֛י לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֧ה יו֛י אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃ (זכריה יד:ט]
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Vehaya Adonai lemelekh ‘al kol ha’arets bayyom hahu yihyē Adonai eḥad ushmo eḥad:
content.english: Cantor: And Adonai will be king over the entire world; on that day, Adonai will be one, and His name one. (Zech. 14:9)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד׃ (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one, and does not need any second one.”
